listing.name: Gladiator / OpenGLaD
listing.summary: Explore Gladiator / OpenGLaD and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start the game
steps.instruction: The official archive includes the Gladiator campaigns and the native game. Choose Play after installation; no original commercial files or separate setup program are required. openscen.exe is the optional level editor, not this route’s play target.

steps.title: Prepare your Apple silicon Mac
steps.instruction: The inspected ARM64 player needs macOS 26 and the Apple silicon Homebrew libraries libyaml, physfs, libzip and sdl3 under /opt/homebrew. Follow the upstream Mac setup for those libraries before Play. The managed player opens from its own folder and keeps your saves, campaigns and settings under ~/.openglad.

warnings: Use a separately prepared copy for OPENGLAD_CONFIG_DIR or a custom Mac library search path. Keep the actual OpenGlad profile and its creating runtime before changing versions.
